description: Checks a campaign draft before a reviewer sees it: banned or unsupported claims, offer terms, an unsubscribe link and sender address, estimated spend against the budget cap, and a valid publish time. When everything passes it prepares the exact publish request. Reads only; publishes nothing.

flowIr.description: Checks a campaign draft for claims, spend and timing, and prepares the publish request when it passes. Reads only; publishes nothing.
